title: Brain endothelial responses in acute EAE partially overlap with vascular changes in multiple sclerosis
primary_statistical_unit: animal, donor or independent biological sample
cross_species_primary_comparison: pooled acute EAE gene effects compared with donor level chronic active MS gene effects
meta_analysis_boundary: modified Knapp Hartung intervals cross zero because only three cohorts were available
lesion_stage_boundary: cross sectional comparisons are exploratory and no comparison survived false discovery rate correction
MERFISH_boundary: the targeted panel supports selected inflammatory programs but not a composite BBB specialization score
infection_boundary: infection datasets are retained as Supplementary Table S13 and excluded from the main vascular conclusions
functional_boundary: transcript changes and reduced vascular proliferation do not establish recovery of BBB permeability
GWAS_status: not included in the final manuscript analysis
